units.title: Audio/video transcription and translation
units.acceptanceCriteria: Verify required behavior, rejection paths, source-bound test evidence and private defaults; live acceptance remains separate.
units.implementationStatus: Partial: PR4 implements bounded exact-source WebVTT caption import with media edition bindings, original UTF-8 byte anchors and validated timing. This is supplied-transcript review, not speech recognition. Recognition, translation, durable workers and live qualification remain pending. PR5 adds a bounded local text-translation callback adapter with exact source/text/model/purpose provenance and cancellation; no bundled model, isolation or linguistic acceptance is claimed.

units.title: Durable workers and quality/cost evaluation
units.acceptanceCriteria: Verify required behavior, rejection paths, source-bound test evidence and private defaults; live acceptance remains separate.
units.implementationStatus: Partial: durable UTF8 text job submission, leases, one-shot consumption, trusted current authorization/exact outcome verification and transactional audit/outbox. Dispatch daemon, object/receipt service integration, OCR/model workers, quality/cost evaluation and live/network-session acceptance remain pending. PR7 adds optional trusted terminal stopped/no-output reconciliation, exact receipt binding and safe replay without automatic retry. Qualified receipt services and retry generations remain pending. PR8 adds disposable PostgreSQL17 restricted-network-session contention tests for ledger invariants; specific CI evidence does not establish production deployment acceptance.
